brief: brief-native-2026-11-27.md; the owner's later statements; po/native-plan.md
entry: Technology, from 'Technology and top features' §2: keep Go; Postgres the only required service; the contract is OpenAPI 3.1 (JS-183); live messages to a running playback are server-sent and one-way (JS-197); the catalog stays in step through a change log in Postgres, with no broker (JS-214); search is Postgres first, with a typo rule (JS-204); playback tracing carries the trace through the job row (JS-021). Hardware encoding stays gated on measurement (JS-169, JS-170, JS-054); the measured 31 times x264's bytes on the HD 530 against JS-054's twice-x264 rule is noted for JS-170.
